decisions.statement: The values a seat said before are read from akasha's history and from no older store.
An attribute recovered from history is the bare slug after the last slash.
The assignment is also kept whole.
The page type the assignment names is not lost.
The initiative is taken from its own field rather than from the attributes.
A seat is answered only where the id on the page matches the agent asked for.
A seat with a parent but no person named takes the fleet as its principal.

definition: what a seat last said before its page went, read from akasha's history alone
